page.title: Companies
page.subtitle: The companies you belong to: features, logo and lifecycle

filters.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, slug, id or domain...

form.createDescription: Create a company and choose the features it has. You become its first member.
form.editDescription: Only the features and the logo can change.
form.name: Name
form.slugHint: Lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens.
form.idWarning: The system id is part of every URL of this company and can't be changed after saving. Names that are not in Latin letters need an explicit slug and id.
form.lockedHint: The name, slug and system id can't be changed after creation.
form.logoHint: JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to 5 MB. SVG isn't accepted.
form.logoBadType: Use a JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF picture (SVG isn't accepted).
form.logoTooBig: The logo can't be larger than 5 MB.
form.featuresHint: Features are permissions. Removing “can access admin panel” locks the admin panel for everybody in the company.

errors.nameTooLong: The name can't be longer than 255 characters.
errors.slugInvalid: Use lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens (up to {{max}} characters).

delete.title: Move to trash?
delete.description: “{{name}}” will be locked for everybody in it until it is restored.

restore.title: Restore company?
restore.description: “{{name}}” will be brought back and its members can use it again.

force_delete.title: Delete permanently?
force_delete.description: “{{name}}” and everything in it will be removed for good. This only works for an empty company: no documents, departments, projects, employees, roles or other data, and nobody else as a member. You leave with it.

delete.title: Move {{count}} companies to the trash?
delete.description: They are locked for everybody in them. If any selected company can't be deleted, nothing is changed.

restore.title: Restore {{count}} companies?
restore.description: If any selected company can't be restored, nothing is changed.

force_delete.title: Permanently delete {{count}} companies?
force_delete.description: They and everything in them are removed for good. Only empty companies qualify. If any can't be deleted, nothing is changed.

notice.created: Company created. It has no roles yet: create them before others can work in it.
notice.notFound: That company no longer exists or isn't available to you. The list was refreshed.
notice.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.

states.emptyDescription: Try a different tab, search or filter.
states.forbiddenDescription: You don't have permission to view this screen.
states.notFound: This company no longer exists or isn't available to you.
